Our 4-Stage Engagement Methodology

We work with enterprise CIOs through an intensive, milestones-based transformation roadmap:

Step 1

Architectural Discovery Brief

Initial assessment of legacy infrastructure and workload dependencies.

Step 2

Strategy Consultation with Lead Specialist

Technical deep-dive session to establish target state architecture and compliance posture.

Step 3

Customized Architectural Proposal & Scope

Formal delivery of Statement of Work, migration timetable, and commercial budget.

Step 4

Contract Execution & Project Launch

SLA signing, dedicated engineering sprint allocation, and deployment initiation.
